properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...North Central Liberty County in southeastern Texas...

* WHEN...Until 400 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 106 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain. Flooding is
already occurring in the warned area. Between 6 and 12 inches of
rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Moss Hill.
